arxiv-1905-12289.title: Identity Crisis between supercompactness and Vǒpenka’s Principle Thanks: The third author’s research has been supported by MECD (Spanish Government) Grant no FPU15/00026, MEC project number MTM2017-86777-P and SGR (Catalan Government) project number 2017SGR-270.
arxiv-1905-12289.creator: Yair Hayut, Menachem Magidor, Alejandro Poveda
arxiv-1905-12289.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Yair Hayut, Menachem Magidor, Alejandro Poveda. In this paper we study the notion of C ( n ) C^{(n)} -supercompactness introduced by Bagaria in [ Bag12 ] and prove the identity crises phenomenon for such class. Specifically, we show that consistently the least supercompact is strictly below the least C ( 1 ) C^{(1)} -supercompact but also that the least supercompact is C ( 1 ) C^{(1)} -supercompact (and even C ( n ) C^{(n)} -supercompact).

arxiv-2102-06718.title: The Compton Scattering Total Cross Section at Next-to-Leading Order
arxiv-2102-06718.creator: Roman N. Lee, Matthew D. Schwartz, Xiaoyuan Zhang
arxiv-2102-06718.description: Abstract An analytic formula is given for the total scattering cross section of an electron and a photon at order α 3 \alpha^{3} . This includes both the double-Compton scattering real-emission contribution as well as the virtual Compton scattering part.

arxiv-2205-00323.description: Abstract . Machine settings and tuning are critical for digital fabrication outcomes. However, exploring these parameters is non-trivial. We seek to enable exploration of the full design space of digital fabrication. To identify where we might intervene, we studied how practitioners approach 3D printing.

arxiv-2208-14565.title: Optimizing Bi-Encoder for Named Entity Recognition via Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2208-14565.creator: Sheng Zhang, Hao Cheng, Jianfeng Gao, Hoifung Poon
arxiv-2208-14565.description: Abstract We present a bi-encoder framework for named entity recognition (NER), which applies contrastive learning to map candidate text spans and entity types into the same vector representation space. Prior work predominantly approaches NER as sequence labeling or span classification.

arxiv-2303-07916.title: Structural stability of the RG flow in the Gross-Neveu model
arxiv-2303-07916.creator: J. Dimock, Cheng Yuan, SUNY at Buffalo, NY 14260, USA
arxiv-2303-07916.description: Abstract We study flow of renormalization group (RG) transformations for the massless Gross-Neveu model in a non-perturbative formulation. The model is defined on a two dimensional Euclidean space with a finite volume. The quadratic approximation to the flow stays bounded after suitable renormalization. We show that for weak coupling this property also is true for the complete flow.

arxiv-2407-04635.title: Hyperbolicity of the sub-Riemannian affine-additive group
arxiv-2407-04635.creator: Zoltán M. Balogh, Elia Bubani, Ioannis D. Platis
arxiv-2407-04635.description: Abstract We consider the affine-additive group as a metric measure space with a canonical left-invariant measure and a left-invariant sub-Riemannian metric. We prove that this metric measure space is locally 4-Ahlfors regular and it is hyperbolic, meaning that it has a non-vanishing 4-capacity at infinity.

arxiv-2511-19875.title: CodeFuse-CommitEval: Towards Benchmarking LLM’s Power on Commit Message and Code Change Inconsistency Detection
arxiv-2511-19875.creator: Qingyu Zhang 1,2 Puzhuo Liu 1,3 Peng Di 1,4 Chenxiong Qian 2 1 Ant Group 2 The University of Hong Kong 3 Tsinghua University 4 The University of New South Wales https://github.com/codefuse-ai/CodeFuse-CommitEval
arxiv-2511-19875.description: Abstract Version control relies on commit messages to convey the rationale for code changes, but these messages are often low quality and, more critically, inconsistent with their diffs—known as message-code inconsistency (MCI). MCIs mislead reviewers, hinder maintenance, contaminate research datasets, and may obscure security patches. Yet, no dedicated benchmark exists to evaluate models for MCI detection.

pmc-11618159.title: New mutations and new phenotypes: a case of Major Histocompatibility Complex Class II Deficiency
pmc-11618159.creator: Xinting Li, Bin Lu, Xiaoli Luo
pmc-11618159.description: Major Histocompatibility Complex Class II Deficiency is a rare primary immunodeficiency disease with autosomal recessive inheritance. It is characterized by the absence of Major Histocompatibility Complex Class II molecules on the surface of immune cells. In this article, we will present a four-month-old baby girl who presented with recurrent fever and progressive exacerbation of respiratory symptoms since a month ago.

pmc-11636094.description: Student experiences learning chemistry have been well studied in chemistry courses but less so in biology courses. Chemistry concepts are foundational to introductory biology courses, and student experiences learning chemistry concepts may impact their overall course experiences and subsequent student outcomes.

pmc-12406052.title: SNAKE: A modular realistic fMRI data simulator from the space-time domain to k-space and back
pmc-12406052.creator: Pierre-Antoine Comby, Alexandre Vignaud, Philippe Ciuciu
pmc-12406052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). We propose a new, modular, open-source, Python-based 3D+time realistic functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data simulation software. SNAKE or Simulator from Neurovascular coupling to Acquisition of K-space data for Exploration of fMRI acquisition techniques. It is the first simulator to simulate the entire chain of fMRI data acquisition, from the spatio-temporal design of evoked brain responses to various 3D sampling strategies of k-space data with multiple coils.

pmc-12469334.title: Switch from Ibalizumab to Lenacapavir in a Rescue Regimen for a Heavily Treatment-Experienced (HTE) Patient with Multidrug-Resistant (MDR) HIV-1 Infection

pmc-12469334.description: Despite the progress of antiretroviral therapy, there are still some patients with (MDR) HIV infection. In this case, international guidelines suggest using new-generation drugs, such as Ibalizumab (IBA) or Lenacapavir (LEN), in combination with an optimized background regimen. Our clinical case concerns a Heavily Treatment-Experienced (HTE) patient with MDR HIV-1 infection.

pmc-12533103.title: Stability analysis of a tunnel face reinforced with bolts considering the intermediate principal stress component
pmc-12533103.creator: Kai Xu, Xiang Chen, Gaofeng Luo, Xuebing Hu, Yong Li, Feng Dai, Junchao Chen

pmc-13689407.creator: James Lima Ferreira, Edivaldo Costa Sousa Junior, Jessylene Almeida Ferreira, Poliana da Silva Lemos, Fernando Neto Tavares, Mirleide Cordeiro dos Santos, Marcio Roberto Teixeira Nunes, Rita Catarina Medeiros Sousa
pmc-13689407.description: We report the near-complete genome of a divergent Megrivirus strain (avian/JF05/BA/BRA) detected in cloacal swabs collected from wild birds in Northeast Brazil. The study highlights the importance of viral surveillance in wild birds.
